body_lead: STT GDC India partners with Uttar Pradesh govt to facilitate establishment of AI City The initiative places a significant focus on fostering a robust AI ecosystem through the establishment and optimisation of cutting-edge data centers and computing infrastructure. Set ETGovernment as your preferred source on Google LUCKNOW: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India (STT GDC India), a leading data center solutions provider, has signed a landmark MoU with the Government of Uttar Pradesh to advance and execute the development of India's first AI City in the state.
